description:
## 1.36.0-dev.127 (2026-08-11)

- Reddit: enter native Compose focus search from the selected comment's bounds when its semantics container is not keyboard-focusable.
- Reddit: prevent every comment keypress from falling through to page scrolling when native focus has no current child.
- Reddit: retain native directional traversal and resolve its focused child back to the owning comment.
